scope: All 84 auctionable Alchemy potions in nine era/use cohorts

rules.reagent_floor_source: Exact audited 3.3.5 recipes priced from the frozen non-circular Hellscream reagent baseline.
rules.gold_scale: Same six saved Lordaeron, Icecrown, and Onyxia faction scale indexes used by the dropped-gear Evidence Pricing review.
rules.proposal_rule: Map each coverage-weighted within-cohort rank onto its fixed Hellscream potion target anchor. Three-realm rows use 72% Quick and 160% High; sparser rows use wider bands. Reagent floors remain separate craftability diagnostics.

39671.name: Resurgent Healing Potion
39671.cohort: Crafted Wrath combat and recovery potions

proposal.reason: Reviewed low-pop starter estimate using the fixed Hellscream cohort anchor and the gold-normalized within-cohort external rank. External gold was not copied. Where the market estimate is below the low-confidence reagent replacement cost, the row is sale-value guidance and a warning not to craft from purchased inputs at the saved baseline.
